an3.55:1.1: jānussoṇī brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho jānussoṇī brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an3.55:1.2: sandiṭṭhikaṃ nibbānaṃ sandiṭṭhikaṃ nibbānanti bho gotama vuccati
an3.55:1.3: kittāvatā nu kho bho gotama sandiṭṭhikaṃ nibbānaṃ hoti akālikaṃ ehipassikaṃ opanayikaṃ paccattaṃ veditabbaṃ viññūhīti.
an3.55:2.1: ratto kho brāhmaṇa rāgena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto attabyābādhāyapi ceteti parabyābādhāyapi ceteti ubhayabyābādhāyapi ceteti cetasikaṃpi dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti
an3.55:2.2: rāge pahīne neva attabyābādhāyapi ceteti na parabyābādhāyapi ceteti na ubhayabyābādhāyapi ceteti na cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti
an3.55:2.3: evaṃpi kho brāhmaṇa sandiṭṭhikaṃ nibbānaṃ hoti …
an3.55:3.2: mūḷho kho brāhmaṇa mohena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto attabyābādhāyapi ceteti parabyābādhāyapi ceteti ubhayabyābādhāyapi ceteti cetasikaṃpi dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti
an3.55:3.3: mohe pahīne neva attabyābādhāyapi ceteti na parabyābādhāyapi ceteti na ubhayabyābādhāyapi ceteti na cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti
an3.55:3.4: evaṃ kho brāhmaṇa sandiṭṭhikaṃ nibbānaṃ hoti …
an3.55:4.1: yato kho ayaṃ brāhmaṇa anavasesaṃ rāgakkhayaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti anavasesaṃ dosakkhayaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti anavasesaṃ mohakkhayaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti
an3.55:4.2: evaṃ kho brāhmaṇa sandiṭṭhikaṃ nibbānaṃ hoti akālikaṃ ehipassikaṃ opanayikaṃ paccattaṃ veditabbaṃ viññūhīti.
an3.55:5.2: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti. 57
